title: Pin assert_lost_bind_replayed_identically to the first bind and its replay
outcome: assert_lost_bind_replayed_identically in src/tests/engram_post_receipt.rs asserts that the session's first session_bind (binds[0]) is the request replayed (binds[1]) on the same connection, as the backoff-retry test already does. It no longer accepts any adjacent identical pair, so a missing eager-bind replay cannot pass it on another pair.
acceptance: Pin assert_lost_bind_replayed_identically to the first bind and its replay is done
